verification.method: Node VM using tests/harness.cjs to load production classic scripts. Minimal document.head and parent stubs plus captured requestAnimationFrame permit fixture boot. Fixture commands invoke production step and draw against mocked DOM/canvas; no browser or real image rendering verified.

initialScenarios.method: Enumerate fixture roster; select each ID; advance 60 ticks; assert snapshot has no error and tick equals 60.

controlScenarios.method: For each of 49 IDs, reset via select then independently invoke mirror, woundboss, killboss, or killenemy; advance 60 ticks and assert no snapshot error.

limitations: VM canvas and image loader stubs do not establish visual correctness or actual sprite loading.
No connected-browser, mobile-device, multiplayer, native SDK, score, or publishing verification performed.
isolation: Normal UI update callback disabled within disposable fixture; production step/draw retained. QA source files frozen for packaging.
